name: coffee-pub-studio
description: Wraps the FoundryVTT Game and Stream views in two fixed-size Chromium windows that OBS can capture as sources.
author: Coffee Pub

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/parking.js && node --check src/obs.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/bar-preload.js && node --check src/dock-preload.js && node --check src/dock/dock.js && node --check src/control/control.js && node --check src/bar/bar.js

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Coffee Pub Studio needs the microphone if you use FoundryVTT audio/video chat inside the Game window.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Coffee Pub Studio needs the camera if you use FoundryVTT audio/video chat inside the Game window.
